one_line: Chishti Sufi master of Delhi and Gulbarga who spread Persian, Arabic and early Dakhni learning in the Deccan.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his late 60s to early 70s, medium build, slightly stooped but walking steadily with calm composure.
appearance.face: Oval face with a gently lined forehead, warm medium-brown North Indian complexion, soft but alert almond-shaped eyes under slightly arched brows, a long straight nose, neatly trimmed grey moustache and full flowing grey beard; default expression is serene and thoughtful, with a faint, kind smile.
appearance.hair: Hair mostly hidden beneath a modest white cotton turban wound in simple Delhi–Deccan 14th–15th century style, with a narrow maroon band showing at the base; a few grey wisps visible near the temples when seen from the side.
appearance.costume: A long, loose, ankle-length cotton robe (kurta/khirqa) in soft off-white with very fine vertical weave, worn over a slightly wider-sleeved light-grey under-tunic; a simple, unpatterned, deep maroon woollen shawl draped over his shoulders and wrapped once around his torso, its ends hanging evenly; straight-cut, loose cream churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; plain brown leather slippers with slightly upturned toes; minimal jewellery limited to a single simple silver ring on his right hand, signifying humility and focus on scholarship rather than opulence.
appearance.signature: A well-used, medium-sized bound manuscript volume of Jawami-ul-Kilam–style discourses in a brown leather cover with simple tooling, often cradled in his left arm while his right hand gestures gently as if teaching.

ref_desc: Bande Nawaz Gesudaraz is an elderly medium-built Sufi with warm brown skin, a flowing grey beard, a simple white turban with a maroon band, wearing an off-white robe, cream trousers, a deep maroon shawl, brown leather slippers, and carrying a brown leather-bound manuscript.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Bande Nawaz Gesudaraz as an elderly but dignified Chishti Sufi scholar: he has a medium build, warm brown North Indian complexion, an oval face with gentle lines, calm almond eyes, a long straight nose, a neatly trimmed grey moustache and a full flowing grey beard, his default expression serene and slightly smiling. His hair is mostly concealed under a modest white cotton turban wound simply, with a narrow deep maroon band visible at the base and a few grey wisps at the temples. He wears an ankle-length, loose off-white cotton robe with fine vertical weave over a light-grey under-tunic, a straight, cream churidar-style trouser that gathers at the ankles, and plain brown leather slippers with slightly upturned toes. A deep maroon woollen shawl is draped over his shoulders and wrapped once around his torso, its ends hanging evenly at the front, and he has a single simple silver ring on his right hand. His signature prop is a worn brown leather-bound manuscript volume held in his left arm while his right hand is slightly raised in a gentle teaching gesture. Show him from front, side and back to clearly display the white turban with maroon band, off-white robe, cream trousers, deep maroon shawl and brown slippers, keeping the overall palette of off-white, cream, deep maroon, light grey and brown leather consistent.
